name: Supreme Fire Breather
body:
Your fire breathing ability is terrifyingly deadly.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro fire breather special torch attack class feature, Master Fire Breather, base attack bonus +8.

Benefit(s): Your fire breather special torch attack ability inflicts 1d10 points of damage per two levels and the fire cone increases to 25 ft.
